inputs.xtext_rule_text:
OwnedRedefinition returns SysML::Redefinition:
	  redefinedFeature = [SysML::Feature | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain
;

decision: As SysML 8.2.2.6.5 states it: `redefinedFeature = [QualifiedName]`, or `redefinedFeature = OwnedFeatureChain` with the chain owned by the relationship. The cross-reference parses a QualifiedName. The `{ ownedRelatedElement += ... }` action consumes no tokens. This is the SysML variant (ADR-0014). The Xtext states the same two alternatives.

evidence.note: OwnedRedefinition : Redefinition = redefinedFeature = [QualifiedName] | redefinedFeature = OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += ... }
line 12: `attribute :>> localClock.currentTime = startTime + elapseTime;`, a chain
OwnedRedefinition: redefinedFeature = [SysML::... | QualifiedName] | ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain. Agrees.
